Mercy Cares Counseling

Spirit, Soul, Body

Greetings!

Mercy Cares Counseling is a counseling service which focuses on the clients SPIRIT, SOUL, and BODY.

Clients can expect:

  • a warm and compassionate counselor whose greatest desire is to help them overcome their challenges
  • A clinician that builds authentic relationships by creating a safe environment for the individual
  • Personable and authentic staff that will never have you questioning whether or not you are the priority

Services & Fees

Services

At Mercy Counseling our top specialties are Mood Disorders, Trauma and PTSD, and Addiction.

We also have a wide variety of expertise that includes:

  • Anger Management
  • Anxiety
  • Bipolar Disorder
  • Christian Counseling
  • Codependency
  • Coping Skills
  • Drug Abuse
  • and more...

If there are any questions about any of the services we provide please contact us.
